_comment: Copy this file to config.json (same folder) and edit. config.json is git-ignored: it is the only place a notification target belongs. Every key below is optional — delete what you do not use and the defaults in keeper/config.py apply.

notify._hermes_comment: channel=hermes → runs `hermes send --to <target> --json <text>`. Targets are tried in order (first = primary). Hermes is a local bot gateway: https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent. WeChat targets can be refused until you send the bot one inbound message, so a second target is worth having.
notify._webhook_comment: channel=webhook → one POST. Payload is shaped by hostname: qyapi.weixin.qq.com / oapi.dingtalk.com (text), pushplus (html), *.ftqq.com Server酱 (form), anything else {title,text}.

alert._comment: Failures are only announced from this minute of the vendor day onward, so five trigger slots cannot produce five panic messages. Set it to your last slot's hour*60.
